description: Paper-specific lesson.
Sim_2025_gold_final: EOM single diode works if carrier/multimode leakage filtered hard.
McCormick_2007_OL: Probe absorption + imbalance dominate; natural abundance adds 87Rb structure.
McCormick_2008_PRA: Slow-light delay compensation improves low-frequency squeezing/bandwidth.
Vogl_2012_SPIE: Compact diode/TA works; exact TPD + dispersion bottleneck.
Liu_2011_OL: Pump power tunes bandwidth but raises scatter; temp/angle critical.
Wu_2019_OE: Dual seeding suppresses seed and gain/absorption noise.
de_Araujo_2024_OE: Homodyne needs group-delay compensation + spatial mode matching.
Allen_2026_OE: Long-term stability mainly laser frequency + etalon temperature.
Jain_2025_OL: Fiber source limited by coherence area/spatial filtering, not only insertion loss.
Monsa_2026_preprint: One EOPM + one FP etalon may reach Sim-class IDS at lower pump.

description: Difference from Sim et al. gold reference.
Sim_2025_gold_final: Gold reference for GABES defaults and line_strength=0.74.
McCormick_2007_OL: Natural abundance, hotter, longer path, lower pump, larger angle, worse eta.
McCormick_2008_PRA: Lower temp, larger pump waist, higher seed, opposite TPD convention.
Vogl_2012_SPIE: Longer cell, larger angle, lower squeeze, no exact TPD sign/value.
Liu_2011_OL: TPD sign opposite GABES; +4 MHz paper -> -4 MHz GABES.
Wu_2019_OE: Dual-seeded, larger beams/powers, angle often 0.5 deg, TPD sign ambiguous.
de_Araujo_2024_OE: Homodyne/vacuum-seeded, pump split; outside seeded IDS model.
Allen_2026_OE: Close performance but lower temp/pump, larger D4sigma beams, one-etalon leakage.
Jain_2025_OL: Fiber-coupled noise budget/spatial modes differ; not simple loss_pct.
Monsa_2026_preprint: Preprint mirrors Sim OPD/TPD but half pump and missing beam waists.
